biotools.summary: REACTOR is a computational tool used to detect differential activity of transcriptional regulators (regulons) and their target genes using single-cell RNA-sequencing data. It extends regulon analysis by introducing a statistical test to contrast different biological conditions (e.g., disease vs. control).
